blocks.en:
Find the eigenvalues and eigenfunctions for the following boundary-value problem:\[\begin{aligned}
-u''-\lambda u&=0,\\
u'(0)&=0,\\
\cos\beta\,u(1)+\sin\beta\,u'(1)&=0.
\end{aligned}\]
blocks.zh:
求下列边值问题的特征值和特征函数:\[\begin{aligned}
-u''-\lambda u&=0,\\
u'(0)&=0,\\
\cos\beta\,u(1)+\sin\beta\,u'(1)&=0.
\end{aligned}\]

blocks.en: Consider the S-L problem \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-inhomogeneous-differential-equation} with Dirichlet boundary conditions. Let $\lambda_n$ be the eigenvalues and let $\phi_n$ be the normalized eigenfunctions. Let $u\in L^2(a,b)$ have the expansion $u(x)=\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\alpha_n\phi_n(x)$. Prove that\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]\item $u\in H^2(a,b)\cap H_0^1(a,b)$ iff $\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}(1+\lambda_n^2)|\alpha_n^2|<\infty$.\item $u\in H_0^1(a,b)$ iff $\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}(1+|\lambda_n|)|\alpha_n|^2<\infty$.\end{enumerate}Hint for (b): Consider the inner product $(u,Lu)_w$.
blocks.zh: 考虑具有 Dirichlet 边界条件的 S-L 问题 \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-inhomogeneous-differential-equation}. 设 $\lambda_n$ 为特征值, $\phi_n$ 为归一化特征函数. 设 $u\in L^2(a,b)$ 具有展开式 $u(x)=\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\alpha_n\phi_n(x)$. 证明:\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]\item $u\in H^2(a,b)\cap H_0^1(a,b)$ 当且仅当 $\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}(1+\lambda_n^2)|\alpha_n^2|<\infty$.\item $u\in H_0^1(a,b)$ 当且仅当 $\sum_{n\in\mathbb{N}}(1+|\lambda_n|)|\alpha_n|^2<\infty$.\end{enumerate}(b) 的 Hint: 考虑内积 $(u,Lu)_w$.
blocks.label: ex:sturm-liouville-spectral-sobolev-characterizations
